decisions.reason: It builds directly on the firm's core authentication and secure communication capabilities, and with strong in-house R&D the firm is likely to retain and refine it despite only moderate website prominence.

This security architecture is strongly aligned with the firm's established cryptography and platform knowledge and its dedicated product page suggests enough strategic importance to continue developing it.

Although the hardware element makes it somewhat more specialized, it remains close to the firm's identity and signature business and the firm's absorptive capacity supports continued exploitation rather than exit.

Compliance-oriented payment security fits the firm's existing security and regulatory expertise, so a medium-sized German security vendor with its own R&D would usually keep it as a related extension of the core offer.
